The <b>{{PAGENAME}}</b> is one of sixteen(16) different '[[Fishing|fish]]' that can be caught, and either sold to the [[Lighthouse Keeper]], processed for [[cooking]], or - in it's particular case, once studied - processed into a [[Electric powder|powder]] for use in [[alchemy]]. The difficulty in catching it is relatively low, thus it's thought to be a relatively low-tier fish.

==Fishing==
The odds of catching a fish are affected primarily by the other fish in the area at that time.  More competition means your chance of catching a particular fish over another is lowered.  Here is a table of this fish's preferences by the bait used, the place you choose to fish, where you choose to cast, the rod you use, and the time of day.
